builtinModels.name: Composer Lite
builtinModels.description: Chat model (~1 GB). Talks with you and calls Composer Full when workspace edits are needed.

builtinModels.name: Composer
builtinModels.description: Workspace worker (~4.7 GB). Called by Composer Lite for file edits — keeps working until the task is finished.

recommendedConnections.name: Ollama
recommendedConnections.hint: Local models via Ollama. Install Ollama, pull a model (e.g. ollama pull qwen2.5-coder), then refresh.

recommendedConnections.name: LM Studio
recommendedConnections.hint: Local OpenAI-compatible server from LM Studio. Start the local server, then refresh models.

recommendedConnections.name: OpenAI
recommendedConnections.hint: GPT models via the OpenAI API. Paste your API key from platform.openai.com.

recommendedConnections.name: OpenRouter
recommendedConnections.hint: One key for many cloud models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, etc.). Get a key at openrouter.ai.

recommendedConnections.name: Groq
recommendedConnections.hint: Fast cloud inference. Create an API key at console.groq.com.

recommendedConnections.name: Together AI
recommendedConnections.hint: Open-weight cloud models. API keys from api.together.xyz.

recommendedConnections.name: DeepSeek
recommendedConnections.hint: DeepSeek chat/coder models. Keys from platform.deepseek.com.

recommendedConnections.name: Custom endpoint
recommendedConnections.hint: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint (vLLM, Azure OpenAI proxy, self-hosted, etc.).
